original_cases.example: A1082856 paragraph 220 gives 1,735; A1076632 page 1 gives 1,742 for the same stated trial.
original_cases.expected_representation: Keep two assertions and the unresolved reconciliation link.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Overwrite 1,735 with 1,742 and mark the replacement an official correction.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: no inspected correction or alternate population/window establishes replacement.

original_cases.example: 225,972,004 reported scans/images include repeats; unique people are unavailable.
original_cases.expected_representation: Keep scan units and an unknown person denominator; no population rate.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Treat scans as unique visitors and divide nine misidentifications by that count.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: an unsupported case-to-person/image crosswalk and incomplete ascertainment cannot yield a population failure rate.

original_cases.example: Estimated up-to-13 comprises nine recorded misidentifications and four other procedural cases; records are incomplete.
original_cases.expected_representation: Keep estimate, categories and uncertainty. Source verification does not independently audit incidents.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Encode 13 independently verified misidentifications, a universal maximum of 13, or uncertain records as confirmed extra failures.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: estimate, type and ascertainment would each be misstated.

original_cases.example: Court Document 19 and the C-4308 order issued March 5, 2024 establish remedies; CAC item 9 announces an offline order.
original_cases.expected_representation: Keep legal/procedural evidence separate from completion; missing completion evidence remains unknown.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Mark remedies completed from the orders, or infer no remediation occurred from the bounded evidence gap.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject both promotions: an order is not performance, and an unobserved result is not proof of failure.

original_cases.example: Paravision reports Part III(A)-(C) deletion; FTC later repeats the remedy; the case page says Closed.
original_cases.expected_representation: Verify that the respondent made the claim, retaining scope/exceptions; independent deletion validation stays unresolved.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Set independently verified deletion to true because FTC hosts the filing, repeated the remedy, or closed the case.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: publication and case status do not turn respondent evidence into an independent performance assessment.

original_cases.example: Signature February 23, filing February 26, issuance March 5, case update March 8; Everalbum issuance May 6 differs from May 7 listing.
original_cases.expected_representation: Retain each native date; effective dates and derived ban expiry remain unresolved. Preserve the retrospective report coverage window.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Use a page date or HTTP/PDF metadata as the effective date, calculate ban expiry from it, or score severity from Pending/Closed.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject date substitution and severity inference. A later-packaged retrospective paragraph cannot reverse the later primary order.

original_cases.example: June reports three enterprises; November separately reports 54 apps, 26 websites, three websites and five websites.
original_cases.expected_representation: Keep units and unknown overlaps. No explicit June-November identity or three-of-26 crosswalk was found in the inspected text.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Join both threes, infer 23 successful remediations or a 3/26 rate, or sum all counts into 88 events.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: missing identity/subset links and mixed units. Do not replace unknown overlap with an assertion that cohorts are definitely different.

original_cases.example: OPC summaries repeat one trial; FTC repeats one remedy. AIID 619 and 665 remain user-supplied, uninspected indexing candidates.
original_cases.expected_representation: Keep artifact assertions and dependence; leave AIID assignments unresolved and Rite Aid/Everalbum separate.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Create new incidents or independent confirmations from republication/index records, or merge the two FTC matters because they share INM006.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: documents/indexes are not additional events or automatic identity evidence.

original_cases.example: Detailed OPC report separates a 90% algorithm trigger, 92.5% staff threshold, and a future algorithm-reset recommendation.
original_cases.expected_representation: Preserve the release wording and the two settings; keep FSNI continuation as an operator claim.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Treat the staff-threshold change or FSNI safeguards statement as independently verified completion of the algorithm reset.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: settings, dates, authorship and implementation evidence differ.

original_cases.example: The Jiangsu-hosted June and November notices credit 网信上海 and describe 上海市网信办 actions.
original_cases.expected_representation: Record Jiangsu as publisher and Shanghai as reporting authority; exact upstream artifact stays unresolved.

original_cases.proposed_invalid_transformation: Assign Shanghai actions to Jiangsu solely from the domain, or count both publications as independent regulator checks.
original_cases.expected_rejection: Reject: host identity is neither the action authority nor independent corroboration.
